answer: Yes, you may be eligible to defer if you missed the exam because you were unwell, provided you get a medical certificate (or an approved alternative) from your doctor or a campus health service. Get it immediately, and apply by 11.55pm on the exam's set date.

points.text: Get a medical certificate (or an approved alternative) from your doctor or a campus health service straight away, as it is needed to be considered eligible to defer.
